source: Lowell P. Beveridge, Jr., The Colony: Stories from a Down East Island (2016)
caption_policy: Captions are concise summaries of the book's printed captions, not verbatim transcriptions. The original caption remains visible in the preserved scan and can be read on the linked PDF page. Dates are only quoted where the printed caption includes them; they are not inferred from publication year.
visual_review: Reviewed image-bearing pages from the supplied clean 305-page PDF. Decorative chapter headings, maps, pure-text pages and tabular documents have been excluded from the PHOTOGRAPHS gallery; these remain available in the complete book. Some source pages may contain additional images not separately cataloged.
